name: Zen Stone 静石留白空间
description: 章节编号、单图观察、材料矩阵、留白结语
source: ClawHive-authored style card; no external vendor assets included.
pptFallback: 复杂 CSS 效果改为静态填充、渐变或烘焙背景，文字和形状保持原生

typography.title_stack: Inter, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif
typography.title_stack_ppt: Arial, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif

behavior: 气质：安静、平衡、冥想；视觉语汇：石色底与细边框、单一主视觉、大块呼吸留白；装饰：stone-toned frame, tiny number and no ornamental clutter；构图：single-focus composition; secondary detail recedes
coverStructure: one object or sentence floating in a calm field
sectionStructure: slow chapter cadence with a pause page when needed
titleTreatment: small index plus generous serif/sans title
decorativeLanguage: stone-toned frame, tiny number and no ornamental clutter
